ID Badge Maker

Create a photo ID badge with name, role, ID number and company branding — rendered as a printable badge.

For novelty, events, cosplay and mockups — not a real credential. The striped code is decorative. Your photo never leaves your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a headshot photo for the badge.
  2. Type the name, role, ID number and company.
  3. Pick a theme color.
  4. Click "Download badge" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What size is the badge?

The badge is rendered at 640 × 1000 px PNG, a standard vertical badge ratio.

Does the barcode work?

The striped code at the bottom is decorative artwork, not a real scannable code.

Can I use it as a real staff ID?

For novelty, events, cosplay and mockups. Don't use it to impersonate staff or gain access anywhere.
